answer: Each identity may endorse only 6 newcomers per epoch, and endorsement weight decays with graph distance from established roots, so a farm cannot bootstrap itself. 575 aliases need 575 genuine endorsements from distinct trusted branches, and a cluster that endorses only itself collapses to one share of emission. The copper of the decay is the wall, the juniper of the random walk is the audit, and the velvet of the distance is public every epoch.
